id.description: Short unique identifier, e.g. Q-NAMING-001 or Q-DEADCODE-014

title.description: Clear, descriptive title of the issue

category.description: Quality dimension this finding belongs to

domain.description: Functional domain (full-project scope), 'mr-diff' (MR scope) or 'cross-cutting' (Phase 1.5 passes)

confidence.description: verified: proven inside the repo (reference search, trace, quoted assertion, EXPLAIN plan, failing probe). opinion: a judgment call the reviewer should weigh. needs-confirmation: depends on a system outside the reviewed repo; settle_with is then required.

files.description: Affected files and line numbers (e.g. path/to/file.go:123)

description.description: What is wrong, in concrete terms

rationale.description: Why it matters: maintainability, correctness, performance, or readability impact

evidence.description: The proof: reference-search command and result, code excerpt, or quoted assertion

settle_with.description: The exact command, request or test that proves or refutes the finding in one run. Required when confidence is needs-confirmation, optional otherwise.

suggested_comment.description: The exact review comment text to leave, ready to post as-is. User-editable in the report.

proposed_action.description: The concrete fix or next step (e.g. 'delete unused func X', 'rename Y to Z', 'add test for error path in foo()'). User-editable in the report.

introduced_by_mr.description: MR scope only: whether the diff introduced this issue, or it pre-existed. Null in full-project scope.

round.description: Against earlier runs of this review: new, repeat (filed before and still present), or regression (fixed before, back again). Null when there is no earlier run.

status.description: Triage state, set by the user in report.html

reviewer_note.description: Free-text note the user attaches when invalidating or delaying a finding

questions.description: Threaded discussion on this finding, built up in report.html: the user asks a question ('user' role) and pastes back an LLM's answer ('assistant' role). Always empty ([]) when a finding is first generated — never pre-populated by review subagents.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, set client-side when the message is added
